title: Line sketch: Melting Pumpkin
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A vibrant pumpkin rests on a rocky base, its lower half dramatically melting and oozing into and viscous forms that drip onto the surface below. The surreal composition features glossy highlights and tendrils against a solid background, evoking a sense of playful decay (derived from painting #716).
